sessions.title: Foundation — Remove Fakes, Fix Feed Bugs, Document Correct API

smart_config.role: CNC Post Processor Engineer + Fusion 360 API Specialist

sessions.intent: After this session, every existing PRISM-enhanced post produces correct feed rates. All fake HTTPClient code is removed. The CORRECT Fusion 360 add-in architecture is documented: add-in modifies operation S/F via adsk.cam API, post reads normal spindleSpeed/feed values. No property bridge needed.

U-PPR01.title: Remove fake HTTPClient from PRISM.cps and all enhanced posts
U-PPR01.description: Strip ALL HTTPClient/httpGet/httpPost calls from PRISM.cps and the 14 enhanced posts. These do NOT exist in the Fusion 360 CPS runtime. Also remove any getGlobalParameter('prism:*') calls — the CPS runtime cannot read add-in custom attributes via getGlobalParameter(). When PRISM add-in data is needed, the add-in writes S/F directly to operation params via adsk.cam BEFORE posting — the post just reads normal spindleSpeed and feed values. For extra data (force, confidence, tool life), the add-in writes to operation comments which the post can read via getParameter('operation:comment').
abort_criteria: Any CPS file contains 'HTTPClient'
Any CPS file contains 'httpGet' or 'httpPost'
Any CPS file contains getGlobalParameter('prism:') calls
Post fails Fusion 360 syntax validation
U-PPR01.exit_gate: grep -r 'HTTPClient\|httpGet\|httpPost\|getGlobalParameter.*prism' data/posts/ scripts/fusion360-post/ returns 0 matches. npx vitest run src/__tests__/ppg-*.test.ts passes.

U-PPR02.title: Fix feed rate bugs in all 14 enhanced posts
U-PPR02.description: Apply the v8.9.154 feed rate fix pattern to all 14 enhanced posts: feedFormat decimals:0 for milling, feedFormatPrecise for tapping/threading (decimals:4 inch, 3 mm), cycleFeedOutput auto-selector in canned cycles, Math.round() before comparison in getFeed(). Sub-1 IPM feeds (finish passes, probing) must keep decimals. Each post must be individually verified with at least one milling and one tapping scenario.
abort_criteria: Any post outputs F with >0 decimals for non-tapping milling moves
Any post outputs F0 for tapping
Any post has missing F on cutting lines
Sub-1 IPM feed loses precision
U-PPR02.exit_gate: All 14 posts pass feed format validation: milling F80 (no decimals), tapping F0.0500 (4 decimals inch), sub-1 F0.003 preserved. npx vitest run src/__tests__/ppg-*.test.ts passes.

U-PPR03.title: Document PRISM Add-in Direct CAM API Architecture
U-PPR03.description: Create the canonical architecture document for how the PRISM Fusion 360 add-in passes physics-optimized parameters to posts. CORRECT mechanism: (1) Add-in calls PRISM server HTTP API to get physics S/F for each operation's tool+material+machine context. (2) Add-in modifies operation parameters DIRECTLY via adsk.cam.Operation.parameters — sets spindleSpeed, surfaceSpeed, feedPerTooth, feedrate etc. (3) Post processor reads normal spindleSpeed/feed values — no custom property bridge needed. (4) For extra data (force N, power kW, confidence %, tool life min, stable RPM range), add-in writes to operation comments as structured JSON: {prism:{force:1234,power:2.1,confidence:0.92,tool_life_min:45,stable_rpm_min:6800,stable_rpm_max:7600}}. Post reads via getParameter('operation:comment') and parses. (5) When add-in is absent, post works normally with CAM-programmed values. Define fallback behavior, version negotiation (prism_version field in comment JSON).
abort_criteria: Spec references getGlobalParameter for custom attributes
Spec assumes CPS can make HTTP calls
Spec doesn't define fallback for absent add-in
No test validating comment JSON parse
U-PPR03.exit_gate: Spec reviewed. Engine created with comment JSON schema + parse/serialize helpers. npx vitest run src/__tests__/prism-addin-architecture.test.ts passes with parse+serialize+fallback tests.

sessions.title: Safety Foundations — NaN Guards, Input Validation, Collision Detection

smart_config.role: Safety-Critical Software Engineer + CNC Collision Prevention Specialist

sessions.intent: After this session, NO code path in the pipeline can produce NaN/Infinity S or F. Bad input produces clear errors, not dangerous output. Basic collision hazards (rapid at cutting depth, missing Z retract before tool change) are detected. Every T use has a preceding M06. This session was MOVED from S11 in v1 per scrutiny finding: safety guards must be in place BEFORE any physics or generation work.

U-PPR04.title: NaN/Infinity guards on ALL numeric pipeline outputs
U-PPR04.description: Audit every stage in PostProcessorPipelineEngine that produces S or F values. Add guards: if isNaN(rpm) || !isFinite(rpm), replace with conservative default from MachineRegistry (50% of max_rpm) and add WARNING comment in output. Same for feed. Also guard: force (Fc), power (P_kW), confidence, tool_life. Log every guard activation for debugging. This is the FIRST line of defense — all subsequent sessions depend on this.
abort_criteria: Any numeric output can be NaN under any input
Any numeric output can be Infinity under any input
Guard replaces NaN with 0 instead of conservative default
Guard silently drops NaN without logging
U-PPR04.exit_gate: Fuzz test with 50 random inputs (missing material, zero diameter, null machine) produces 0 NaN outputs. npx vitest run src/__tests__/ppg-nan-guards.test.ts passes with >=10 negative test cases.

U-PPR05.title: Input validation layer — reject bad input early with clear errors
U-PPR05.description: Add validation at pipeline entry (Stage 0.0): (1) G-code must contain at least one motion block (G0/G1/G2/G3), (2) Tool numbers must be positive integers, (3) Coordinates must be within ±99999mm, (4) Machine ID must resolve in MachineRegistry, (5) Material must resolve in MaterialRegistry or be 'unknown' (triggers conservative defaults). Each validation failure produces a structured error with: field, value, reason, suggestion. Pipeline STOPS on validation failure — does not produce partial/dangerous output.
abort_criteria: Empty G-code passes validation
Tool number 0 or -1 passes validation
Missing machine ID produces output instead of error
Validation error message is generic ('invalid input')
U-PPR05.exit_gate: Empty input → PipelineValidationError. Tool T-1 → error. Coordinate X999999 → error. All error messages include field+value+reason. npx vitest run src/__tests__/ppg-input-validation.test.ts passes with >=8 negative test cases.

U-PPR06.title: Collision detection basics — rapid at cutting depth, missing Z retract
U-PPR06.description: Add collision hazard detection in pipeline safety stage: (1) Rapid (G0) at Z depth below material top → WARNING: possible collision, (2) Tool change (M06) without preceding Z retract (G28 Z / G53 Z / safe Z move) → ERROR: tool change at cutting depth, (3) Rapid XY move at cutting depth (no Z retract first) → WARNING: lateral rapid at depth. These are not full simulation — just pattern-based hazard detection on the G-code output. Each hazard gets severity (WARNING vs ERROR) and line number reference.
abort_criteria: G0 Z-50 (rapid to depth) not flagged
M06 without Z retract not flagged
Engine crashes on valid G-code with no hazards
TypeScript build fails
U-PPR06.exit_gate: Detects rapid-at-depth, tool-change-without-retract, lateral-rapid-at-depth in test fixtures. Clean programs produce 0 warnings. npx vitest run src/__tests__/ppg-collision-detection.test.ts passes.

U-PPR07.title: Tool change sequence validation — every T use has preceding M06
U-PPR07.description: Validate that every tool use (T code followed by cutting motion) has a preceding M06 tool change command. Detect: (1) T2 followed by cutting without M06 → ERROR, (2) M06 with no T code → WARNING, (3) Multiple T codes without M06 between → ERROR. Also validate WCS-aware travel limits: when machine has G54-G59 offsets defined, travel limit checks must account for the active WCS offset — X100 in G55 might be X200 in machine coordinates.
abort_criteria: T2 without M06 before cutting not detected
WCS offset not applied to travel limit check
Engine crashes on programs without tool changes
U-PPR07.exit_gate: Detects missing M06 before cut, orphan M06, duplicate T. WCS-offset travel check catches X100 in G55 exceeding travel. npx vitest run src/__tests__/ppg-tool-change-validation.test.ts passes.

U-PPR47.title: Pipeline stage fusion for large programs
U-PPR47.description: Profile pipeline execution for 500-block and 1000-block programs. Identify stages that can be fused (combined into a single pass). Current pipeline is O(blocks * stages) — reduce to O(blocks * fused_stages) by combining sequential read-only stages. Add benchmarks: 100 blocks < 2s, 500 blocks < 10s, 1000 blocks < 30s. Use worker thread pool (Node worker_threads) for CPU-intensive physics calculations (Kienzle force per block) to leverage multi-core.

Existing PP-MOAT tests fail

U-PPR48.description: Cache SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine results keyed by (tool_geometry_hash, material_iso, machine_id, operation_type, depth, width). Cache hit skips Kienzle+Monte Carlo computation.
